text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hereditary Pyruvate Kinase Deficiency with Secondary Apnea.

Based on the severe anemia and central pallor confirmed by the CBC and smear, combined with the feeding-related apnea, this clinical picture strongly suggests an enzymatic defect in red blood cells like Pyruvate Kinase Deficiency, which causes hemolytic anemia and compensatory apnea. The presence of target cells on the smear further supports this diagnosis. I recommend a quantitative pyruvate kinase enzyme assay and echocardiogram to assess for heart failure secondary to the anemia.
